name: Text in Space
summary: Bold lowercase words placed inside a talking-head shot: behind the speaker's head, bent on arcs, orbiting as a ring, racking in and out of focus, in white and one brand red.

palette.use: stand-in for the footage plate in previews (the real ground is the speaker's shot) (proposed)
grey words and the 9 px sticker outline
the speaker stand-in silhouette in previews (proposed)
emphasis words: the big word behind the head, slams, Six Caps key words
the hard offset shadow under slam words

type.emphasis: brand red and 2-3x the size, behind the head or slammed in front of the body

banned: words over the face or the hands
words off-screen, overlapping each other, or unreadable
capitalised Poppins: main words are lowercase (only Six Caps key words are uppercase)
more than one emphasis colour: white and one brand red
words floating on top of everything: every shot uses the four layers (plate, back words, cutout, front words)
another creator's footage, branding or script; real logos
AI-generated video for the plate: it is the speaker's own locked-off footage
grain, glow or colour grades on the type
